participation.context: Read the roll and put it down.
participation.name: William Shakespeare

relations.note: a part that speaks at the two ends

story.body: You looked at Egeon's roll. He opens the play, then he is idle till the end. The king's leaf stayed face down.

relations.note: a part that speaks at the two ends

title: Read that Egeon opens the play and is idle till the end

relations.note: a part with a long wait in it

story.body: After the opening you were idle. The middle of Errors belonged to other men. You waited for the end.

relations.note: a part with a long wait in it

title: Waited out the middle of Errors

participation.context: Said six-and-thirty back, and left the chest uncounted.
participation.name: William Shakespeare

participation.context: Named the share, kept the lease off the sheet, and named no Rose sum.
participation.name: John Heminges

participation.context: Took the sum, refused an average, and went home.
participation.name: Thomas Pope

participation.context: Took six-and-thirty without asking it to be forty, and went home.
participation.name: Augustine Phillips

participation.context: Took the silver and turned them toward the Jackdaw.
participation.name: Richard Burbage

relations.note: the sheet is the share again

story.body: You said the share back. You did not count the chest. You did not put the lease on the sheet. You did not hear a Rose receipt.

relations.note: the sheet is the share again

participation.context: Told the glass, refused to buy it tonight, and kept the book unshown.
participation.name: William Shakespeare

participation.context: Asked for the break, and closed his hand as on a handle.
participation.name: Richard Burbage

participation.context: Priced the glass at four shillings, and stayed gloomy about giants without naming a Rose sum.
participation.name: John Heminges

participation.context: Gave six days as nineteen lines, and a noise like a goose, and would not read them aloud.
participation.name: Abel Garnish

participation.context: Set dinner at sixpence, and sent the rest of the talk home.
participation.name: Agnes Tipping

relations.note: he wants the break as soon as the way is written

story.body: You gave Burbage the break and kept the writing of the way. Heminges priced the glass at four shillings. Garnish delivered the nineteen lines. Kemp was not in the room, and the book was not shown.
